description: Use this when the user asks whether a security issue was announced for an open-source package, such as "any recent security advisories for ffmpeg?", or what the oss-security list says about a CVE. Pass package (a name such as openssl, ffmpeg or tomcat) or cve, not both. Returns the matching oss-security mailing list threads of the current and previous quarter, newest first: subject, link and the CVE ids in the subject. A thread matches by its subject only, so no match does not mean no advisory. The list is refreshed once a week.

limit.description: How many threads to return, newest first (default 20)

package.description: A package or project name as advisories write it, such as "openssl", "ffmpeg" or "tomcat"

name: search_oss_security
title: Search oss-security advisories
